intro: Paper 1 cutoffs decide who gets called for the physical tests, so they are the number most candidates ask about. Male and female candidates have separate lists.
factors: The 2026 cycle changes the pattern of Paper 1 to 100 questions with a 15-minute timer for each section, so earlier cutoffs out of 200 are only a rough comparison.
Vacancies in the notification and the number of candidates who appear.
Difficulty of the shift. Marks are normalised across shifts.
caveat: Past cutoffs below are out of 200 marks under the old pattern. The scaled figure shows what the same share of marks would be out of 100, but the new pattern is not the same paper, so use it as a rough guide only.
target: Safe zone is a score comfortably above the previous year's UR cutoff in your category, because physical-test shortlists are generated at a fixed ratio to vacancies.
